title: Compass
summary: The Compass public site: homepage, connection guide and advisory index. One monospace family on a night ground, one blue action colour and one amber contact colour. A day view is kept behind the toggle.

direction.product: Compass gives an agent the public vulnerability record and the evidence from projects you select, so it can say what needs a look, with the source and the uncertainty in view.
direction.world: The combat information centre of a ship at night. The lights are down, one screen is lit, and the watch already knows what it will do when a contact is called.
moments: The night globe on the homepage: Earth drawn in characters, lit along one limb, turning slowly, with one contact and its bearing
The Connect via MCP action at the centre of that screen
direction.signature: One amber contact on a dark globe, with its bearing read off the compass ring. Amber is used for nothing else.
voice: Say what is known, where it came from and what is not covered.
A missing match is never called safe.
Short declarative lines, like a report on a net. No urgency words.
Capitals are for instrument labels and the hero title. Sentences that explain stay in sentence case.

license.note: Existing repository terms apply. No new redistribution grant. IBM Plex Mono is shipped under the SIL Open Font License 1.1.
